items.title: NASA Science
items.summary: What spooky planet is this? Planet Earth on a dark and stormy night, of course. The ghostly scene was photographed at Hverir, a geothermally active area found along northeastern Iceland's volcanic landscape. Triggered by solar activity, geomagnetic storms have unleashed energetic particles trapped in Earth's magnetic field. Penetrating the planet's upper atmosphere at high latitudes, the particles create auroral displays in the starry night sky. Ghostly towers of steam and gas are venting from…

items.title: משלחת דיסקברי
items.summary: משלחת דיסקברי (באנגלית: Discovery Expedition) או בשמה הרשמי, "המשלחת הלאומית הבריטית לאנטארקטיקה 1901-04" (British National Antarctic Expedition, 1901–04), הייתה משלחת בריטית רשמית לחקר האזור האנטארקטי, הראשונה מאז פעל באזור זה ג'יימס קלארק רוס שישים שנה קודם לכן. שם המשלחת, "דיסקברי", נגזר משם הספינה שבה הגיעו החוקרים.

items.label: From the classics
items.title: The Bhagavad-Gita — The Song Celestial
items.summary: Find full reward of doing right in right! Let right deeds be thy motive, not the fruit which comes from them.
items.source: Chapter II · trans. Sir Edwin Arnold

items.label: Poem
items.title: Homer — The Odyssey
items.summary:
The man for wisdom’s various arts renown’d,
Long exercised in woes, O Muse! resound;
Who, when his arms had wrought the destined fall
Of sacred Troy, and razed her heaven-built wall,
Wandering from clime to clime, observant stray’d,
Their manners noted, and their states survey’d,
items.source: Book I, opening · trans. Alexander Pope · Project Gutenberg

items.title: A New Map of ‘Empty’ Space Challenges a Tranquil Picture of the Galaxy
items.summary: For decades, astronomers treated the interstellar medium as a static backdrop to the goings-on of the universe. Now, a wave of 3D mapping is bringing the interstellar medium’s dynamic nature into focus. The post A New Map of ‘Empty’ Space Challenges a Tranquil Picture of the Galaxy first appeared on Quanta Magazine
